verdict.rationale: The axis applies because Microsoft Authenticator is an OTP app that holds codes for many accounts. The evidence only shows that it supports multiple accounts, including non-Microsoft services. Nothing documents search, folders or groups, service icons, or any other way to organize a large token list.

support.subject: As a power user, I can keep dozens of tokens organized — search, folders or groups, and service icons — so the right code is always two taps away
